source: Previously downloaded assessment runbook; definitions frozen 2026-10-26.

traits.name: Intent Clarity
traits.definition: openings name the desired outcome or observable target, not only actions.
traits.eligible_when: request whose intended outcome could have been stated.

traits.name: Problem Framing Altitude
traits.definition: symptom/problem/goal level; premature prescriptions abandoned when evidence contradicts.
traits.eligible_when: choosing or revising frame, cause, goal, or direction.

traits.name: Constraint Precision
traits.definition: boundaries, preserved behaviour, non-goals, prohibited actions explicit and honoured.
traits.eligible_when: meaningful scope/preservation/exclusion/reversibility/prohibition boundaries.

traits.name: Falsifiable Acceptance
traits.definition: completion criteria checkable by command, measurement, or observable state.
traits.eligible_when: change/release/deliverable whose completion could be checked.

traits.name: Context Anchoring
traits.definition: references resolve to real artifacts and get used.
traits.eligible_when: they supply or point to a resolvable reference.

traits.name: Evidence Injection
traits.definition: code/logs/traces/screenshots/measurements arrive when they distinguish hypotheses.
traits.eligible_when: decision/diagnosis/claim evidence could settle.

traits.name: Progressive Disclosure
traits.definition: context arrives while it can still influence decisions.
traits.eligible_when: multiple stages or timing-sensitive context.

traits.name: Context Economy
traits.definition: volume/duplication/retrieval cost justified by outcome.
traits.eligible_when: retrieve/paste/repeat/compact with enough outcome signal.

traits.name: Durable Memory and Decision Provenance
traits.definition: decisions, rationale, rejected alternatives become durable.
traits.eligible_when: decision/standard/recurring correction that could outlive the session.

traits.name: Agent State Modeling
traits.definition: accurate assumptions about what model/session/subagent/environment can see.
traits.eligible_when: crossing a visibility boundary.

traits.name: Problem Understanding First
traits.definition: reproduce/trace/hypothesis-test before changing.
traits.eligible_when: failure/ambiguity/competing hypotheses before mutation.

traits.name: Inspect-Before-Edit Discipline
traits.definition: search/reads/state checks before first change.
traits.eligible_when: mutation that could have been inspected first.

traits.name: Capability Provisioning
traits.definition: tools, permissions, credentials, environment access provided.
traits.eligible_when: task needs a capability to finish.

traits.name: Delegation Judgment
traits.definition: subagents for separable/specialized/long/context-heavy work — not because available.
traits.eligible_when: separable work and delegation possible.

traits.name: Decomposition Skill
traits.definition: coherent units with complete scope and independently verifiable outputs.
traits.eligible_when: dividable into two+ units.

traits.name: Agent Brief Quality
traits.definition: delegated prompts carry intent, context, constraints, acceptance, exclusions, format, stop conditions.
traits.eligible_when: a brief you can evaluate was given. Briefs you wrote yourself are not applied unless they wrote or repeatedly corrected them.

traits.name: Parallelism Hygiene
traits.definition: worktrees/ownership/integration protect shared state.
traits.eligible_when: concurrent workers and isolation supported.

traits.name: Result Integration
traits.definition: delegated findings accepted/rejected/reconciled into one decision.
traits.eligible_when: returns required a final decision.

traits.name: Root-Cause Orientation
traits.definition: evidence supports mechanism; symptom patches rejected; failure stops recurring.
traits.eligible_when: causal claim or repair choice that could be tested.

traits.name: Decision Rights Allocation
traits.definition: what agent may decide, what needs approval, when to escalate.
traits.eligible_when: consequential choices, side effects, or autonomous action.

traits.name: Feedback Specificity
traits.definition: corrections name expected vs actual, keep objective, carry evidence.
traits.eligible_when: correction/rejection/redirect after mismatch.

traits.name: Steering and Trust Calibration
traits.definition: intervention, autonomy, verification density track risk and performance.
traits.eligible_when: observable variation in risk/complexity/autonomy.

traits.name: Verification Closure and Independence
traits.definition: acceptance check after final change, channel that did not produce the claim.
traits.eligible_when: change/completion claim with a post-check path.

traits.name: Recovery and Learning Discipline
traits.definition: reverse failed approaches, recognize repeats, make lessons durable.
traits.eligible_when: failed approach, repeated correction/check, or degraded thread.
